content: Advance M0130/W0133 with a host-independent SPIR-V reflection contract after target preflight. Verify compute entry metadata, exact target/workgroup/feature/address-space parity, required builtins and Workgroup storage, and the versioned packed-BDA argument block without claiming MLIR conversion or shader-module creation.

Reflection is represented as observations from a future SPIR-V producer. The verifier rejects malformed entry/model/builtin data, parity mismatches, BDA storage mismatches, Workgroup-storage mismatches, and argument-block sizes that do not equal the canonical 64-byte header plus 48-byte entries; it compares argument target digest to the queried profile.

Content revision d25617a adds SpirvReflection and validate_spirv_reflection, reuses the canonical Vulkan argument-block size helper, and tightens BDA requirements to include storage-buffer address space. The README and W0133 plan record the pre-pipeline boundary.

Target reflection fixtures pass positive and negative entry/model, digest, builtin, argument-size, Workgroup-storage, BDA-space, and existing preflight paths. Full Vulkan CTest passed 88/88 after the final regression.
